reason: Close KF-P0-12 by failure-first proof against exact trusted main. Fresh source review shows the Worker health contract now requires D1 permission-authority migration 0006 while release preflight still declares EXPECTED_D1_SCHEMA_VERSION=5 and does not explicitly bind latestRequiredMigration/permissionAuthorityColumns. Desktop Worker clients also propagate arbitrary remote data.code values instead of enforcing the FACEBOOK_* error family. First implementation must remain tests-only and prove these exact seams through the existing Stage-routed Facebook WP0 contract test; production remains forbidden until a fresh causal RED with unknownBlockers=0 is recorded and a separate same-root production amendment ordinary-merges.

digestCanonicalization.pathNormalization: Require exact repository-relative normalized paths, remove duplicates, then sort with JavaScript default Array.prototype.sort().

requiredSemantics: Preserve the existing official Facebook Page Chatwoot Matrix driver authority and do not mutate platformDriverRegistry.
Preserve Page OAuth retirement at the Desktop legacy Worker boundary; only Personal Identity Worker OAuth remains reachable and must require Worker OAuth contract version 6 or newer.
Preserve exact avatarProxyContract version 11, evidenceContractVersion 6 and the existing deployment marker.

Expose a causal RED proving release preflight does not yet require the Worker D1 permission-authority contract: schema version 6, latestRequiredMigration 0006_permission_authority.sql and permissionAuthorityColumns=true.
Expose a causal RED proving Desktop Worker error propagation does not yet fail closed to the FACEBOOK_* error family when an upstream Worker returns an unrecognized code.
Keep the existing lease-renewal, persisted-attempt header binding, signed request and Chatwoot ownership assertions GREEN.
The first implementation commit must change only the authorized existing WP0 test path and must contain no production mutation.
forbiddenSemantics: No production fix before a fresh exact-head causal RED and unknownBlockers=0.
No second Facebook driver, queue, scheduler, retry engine or contract registry.
No dependency, workflow, routing, schema, package or lockfile change.
No weakening of persisted-attempt, device-signature, D1 fencing, OAuth ownership or Chatwoot Matrix authority.
